record.paper_title: Recent results on functional equations in a single variable, perspectives and open problems
record.context_brief: Berg-Meinardus conjecture and the Collatz connection
record.original_question: Classify all analytic solutions in the open unit disc of the functional equation 3zφ(z^3) = 3zφ(z^6) + φ(z^2) + λφ(λz^2) + λ^2φ(λ^2 z^2), where λ = exp(2πi/3). The Berg-Meinardus conjecture stated in the paper asks whether the only analytic solutions are the Möbius-type functions φ(z) = a + bz/(1-z) with complex constants a and b.

evidence.quote: It is a conjecture of L. Berg and G. Meinardus [37; Conjecture 3], [38; Conjecture 3] that functions (10.1) are the only analytic solutions of (10.2) in the open unit disc. It is interesting that this conjecture is equivalent to the positive answer to the Collatz “3n + 1 problem” [37], [38].

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\lambda = \exp(2\pi i/3)$ be a primitive cube root of unity, and let $\mathbb{D} = \{z \in \mathbb{C} : |z| < 1\}$ denote the open unit disc. Consider the functional equation
$$3z\,\varphi(z^3) \;=\; 3z\,\varphi(z^6) \;+\; \varphi(z^2) \;+\; \lambda\,\varphi(\lambda z^2) \;+\; \lambda^2 \varphi(\lambda^2 z^2)$$
for functions $\varphi : \mathbb{D} \to \mathbb{C}$ analytic on $\mathbb{D}$. For every pair of complex constants $a, b \in \mathbb{C}$, the Möbius-type function
$$\varphi(z) \;=\; a \;+\; \frac{b\,z}{1-z}$$
is an analytic solution on $\mathbb{D}$. Classify all analytic solutions of this functional equation in $\mathbb{D}$. In particular, prove or disprove: every analytic solution on $\mathbb{D}$ is of the above Möbius-type form for some $a, b \in \mathbb{C}$.
artifact.category_tag: Functional equations and the Collatz problem
artifact.status_search_result: The conjecture of Berg and Meinardus, that the only analytic solutions of this functional equation on the unit disc are the Möbius-type functions, is known to be equivalent to the (positive resolution of the) Collatz 3n+1 problem. The Collatz conjecture remains open, and subsequent literature (Opfer 2013, Idriss 2024, and generalizations to Collatz-type maps on rings of integers, 2021) continues to treat this functional-equation reformulation as an unresolved problem.

status_evidence.title: Functional Equations Connected With The Collatz Problem
status_evidence.snippet: Berg and Meinardus prove that the Collatz conjecture is equivalent to the statement that the only analytic solutions of a certain functional equation on the unit disc are of a prescribed Möbius form.
status_evidence.claim: The conjecture is equivalent to the Collatz 3n+1 problem.

status_evidence.title: Functional Equations Associated to Collatz-Type Maps on Integer Rings
status_evidence.snippet: Generalizes the Berg-Meinardus functional-equation approach to broader Collatz-type maps; the original conjecture is still treated as open.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work continues to treat the Berg-Meinardus conjecture as unresolved.

status_evidence.title: Functional Analysis Approach to the Collatz Conjecture
status_evidence.snippet: A 2024 paper revisiting the functional-analytic reformulation of the Collatz conjecture.
status_evidence.claim: As of 2024 the equivalence problem remains unresolved.
